acceptance_rules: Require a unique defensible retained answer, explicit derivation and scrutiny of the alternative from the separate reviewer.
Compare the locked fresh judgment with the initial analyst answer and checked computation; official-key agreement alone never settles truth.
Preserve both judgments and all disagreements, including difficulty and family disagreements, before adjudication.
Resolve material wording or answer concerns with explicit reasoning; rewritten text must be a separately versioned variant and independently revalidated.
Assess near-identical semantic/code templates separately from broad shared skills. Record local family scope and conservative sensitivity grouping.
Do not count reviewed questions as statistically independent merely because text differs or both reviewers agree.
Independent AI review is not independent human validation.
Question-review completion cannot by itself authorize model calls: collection still needs an exact separate plan, models/endpoints, budget, scoring and stopping rules.
next_stage: Adjudicate only after fresh initial review and lock exist.
